relatedItems.titleZh: 比赛尾声混乱，与积分区擦肩而过，车队复盘后备战巴林大奖赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 奥迪F1车队发帖表示比赛末段十分混乱，成绩接近积分区，赛后进行复盘，随后前往马来西亚备战巴林大奖赛。

media.altZh: 比赛尾声混乱，与积分区擦肩而过，车队复盘后备战巴林大奖赛

relatedItems.originalTitle: A hectic end to the race, close to points. Debrief time, then on to Malaysia for the Bahrain GP
relatedItems.summaryEn: A hectic end to the race, close to points. Debrief time, then on to Malaysia for the Bahrain GP
detailZh: 比赛尾声十分混乱，与积分区近在咫尺。复盘时间，然后前往马来西亚，备战巴林大奖赛。
detailEn: A hectic end to the race, close to points. Debrief time, then on to Malaysia for the Bahrain GP
keyPointsZh: 比赛末段混乱，车队最终成绩接近积分区但未能得分
keyPointsEn: The race had a hectic ending with the team finishing close to the points positions
